dict.string: Pi Agent 需要访问您的桌面文件夹,以便在添加项目时选择其中的目录。Pi Agent needs access to your Desktop folder to pick a project directory.
Pi Agent 需要访问您的文稿文件夹,以便在添加项目时选择其中的目录。Pi Agent needs access to your Documents folder to pick a project directory.
